Read-only sweep of main 411e359 for the new rule-7 shape (hardcoded *confident* EpistemicStatus with no licensing basis). No bead. I hold nothing.

The compiler `_ => LinguisticallyEntailed` is not on main. Production of(L2)-style door:

- interview/induce.scala:606 and EpisodeModel :103 stamp Hypothesized. That is the conservative floor just ruled, not a fabricated license.
- story/trajectory.scala:90 and alignment.scala:112-132 stamp StructurallyDerived on derived views, with evidence pointing at the derivation stage. The view is derived; they are not claiming linguistic form.
- amr-interop/AmrCandidates.scala:115 stamps SurfaceExplicit only when the marker has a nonempty span.

No second live LinguisticallyEntailed-without-basis site on this tree. WOG fixture statuses are hand-authored, not a compiler default.

I did not run a gate. New-engineer still owns B6 on the candidate.
